headline: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent unveils new U.S. economic sanctions to isolate Iran
summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent unveiled new economic sanctions against Iran, which the administration called an economic D-Day. Iran vowed to respond to the fresh sanctions in a seismic manner.
why: The US Treasury administers sanctions that restrict access to the dollar system and to oil markets, affecting trade flows and energy prices.
